Separate bitwise C++ exhaustive enumeration across all lengths n1..20 matches all five formulas. Finite checks are corroborative, not mistaken for infinite proof. Scripts and outputs are standalone embedded files.

value.rationale: For the canonical class-IV universal Rule110, the counts at return times one through four stay uniformly bounded while fifth-return states first form an exponentially growing family on lengths 5m. Exact rational spatial zeta, two absent compatible circumferences 5 and15 and surprising Lucas correction describe a natural recurrent-subshift invariant and motivate later classification of more intricate periodic glider patterns. This is an all-length structural result, not an arbitrary small-ring census.
